purpose: v3 (commit 94bbb58) showed agent had 6 schema_errors + 6 state_machine_rejections on 4-fluorophenol, almost all from RDKit 'Can't kekulize' or 'Explicit valence' errors. The model was proposing fragment_smiles values outside the catalogue. v4 adds a compact 'catalogue_summary' block to the LLMPolicy prompt that lists VALID FRAGMENTS and VALID SITES explicitly. Re-run the 4F agent arm to measure whether the error rate drops.

change.format:
PARENT = <smiles>
VALID FRAGMENTS (only these are accepted): [...]\nVALID SITES (atom_index on parent): [...]\nPROPOSE_EDITS option must use one fragment from VALID FRAGMENTS and one site from VALID SITES.
Do not invent fragment_smiles outside this list; do not write multi-fragment SMILES.

headline_finding: Catalogue_summary reduced schema_errors 6 -> 1 and state_machine_rejections 6 -> 4 (both n=1 4F arm). The model now stops inventing SMILES and stays closer to the catalogue. Agent still does not find a qualifying molecule in this single observation (qualifying=0); the remaining failure is selection policy + budget, not SMILES validity.
honest_limitations: n=1 observation; the error reduction could be one-shot variance
agent still finds 0 qualifying molecules; the prompt change improves validity but does not improve scientific selection
true test: also re-run phenol and catechol agent with the new prompt to see if they now reach goal_met (not done in this commit)
intent_check: Same scoring, same threshold, same evaluator. Only the agent's prompt input changed (catalogue_summary added). Baselines and audit untouched.
